## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `bash eng/verify-source.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Behavior changes are covered by tests
- [ ] No new dependency, or the new dependency is MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / ISC and justified below
- [ ] No source API description parsing, ORM, UI framework, or control-plane dependency added
